steps.instruction: Create the primary synthetic session.
Connect the CHILD device to the shared synthetic session.
Connect the ADULT device to the shared synthetic session.
Verify separate CHILD and ADULT role projections.
Execute WAIT from the CHILD device.
Execute the help action.
Execute PAUSE and verify the shared state version.
Break the network connection on one physical device.
Execute a command from the other physical device.
Reconnect the interrupted physical device.
Verify the authoritative stateVersion.
Send and reject a stale-state command without mutation.
Verify the stale command was rejected without mutation.
Execute STOP on the primary synthetic session.
Attempt the delayed command after STOP.
Verify the delayed command was rejected.
Attempt reconnect after STOP.
Verify the primary session remains terminal after reconnect.
Create a second, distinct synthetic session for deletion proof.
Delete the second session's active payload and write its tombstone.
Attempt reconnect and cached-capability use after deletion.
Verify the deleted session cannot be resurrected.
Activate the staging kill switch.
Verify the kill switch blocks new sessions.
Rollback to the receipt-bound known-valid safe-disabled deployment.
Verify the deleted session remains deleted after rollback.
End the proof and delete all remaining synthetic data.

stepResultBinding: Each stepResult must include its exact syntheticSessionId and deploymentId. Steps 1-18 bind the primary session; 19-27 bind deletionSyntheticSessionId. Steps 1-24 bind the active deployment; 25-27 bind rollbackDeploymentId.
